summary_en: A passive image-formation correction method for polarization-multiplexed acousto-optic tunable-filter spectral imagers. A quarter-wave plate and liquid-crystal polarization grating compensate the wavelength-dependent separation of the ordinary and extraordinary channels, substantially reducing registration error while increasing measured signal relative to single-polarization acquisition. It is a direct acousto-optic imaging contribution and should enter the core library.

summary_en: An efficient neural implicit-surface reconstruction method for multi-view forward-looking sonar. Sonar-NeuS replaces slow MLP scene representations with explicit SDF and feature voxel grids, adds elevation-arc hierarchical sampling, and smooths the SDF through Gaussian convolution. The reported method reaches comparable reconstruction quality in about 10 minutes versus roughly 4 hours for prior neural approaches, making it a strong core acoustic-imaging and 3D-reconstruction paper.
